label: AF3 code + AF3 native weights
notes: Reference arm. Same container as af3_openbind.json — the AlphaFold3 fork at
juliabuhmann/alphafold3 @ 1fff5c4 — so the CODE is identical between the two arms
and any difference is attributable to the weights alone.
model_dir holds af3.bin.zst, the DeepMind-issued AlphaFold3 parameters, which you
must request separately (see WEIGHTS_TERMS_OF_USE in the AlphaFold 3 repo).
$HOME and a leading ~ are expanded by run_workflow.sh. --of3_weights is off, so
run_alphafold.py takes its stock parameter-loading path.
num_recycles=3 rather than AlphaFold3's default of 10: it is what the earlier
pooled-PPI benchmarks pinned, and both arms here use the same value, so the
comparison is like-for-like. It does make absolute DockQ here lower than a
stock-default AF3 run would give — see README, 'Limitations'.
